tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The only background. Every canvas and the pane behind it. Never a dark grey.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: The lead figure, the default-mode chip, worktree chips, background shell marks. Reads 8.1:1 on ground.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Branch chip, a live shell timer, done marks, every lit ladder pip but the last two. Reads 13.9:1 on ground.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: The model chip, the running timer, counts, the newest LOG line, live shell rows. In a figure SVG, a white accent means the figure's own colour.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Fail, error, interrupted, the bypassPermissions chip, the last two pips of a ladder, a failed shell row. Reads 6.0:1 on ground.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: TE's fourth encoder colour, which the firmware palette shares with red. The PLAN chip and the wait mark. Alias, never a second hue.

tokens.name: grey
tokens.usage: Captions, zone titles, dial labels, idle timers, older LOG lines, finished shell rows. 4.1:1 on ground: below the 4.5:1 floor, kept exact because it is the firmware's own grey; use it only for secondary text at label size or larger.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Unlit ladder pips and the title rule. A darker shade, never opacity: the pane cannot blend.

tokens.name: corner
tokens.usage: One pixel in each corner of every canvas, one shade off ground, so the terminal does not trim and recentre the picture.

tokens.name: ink-on-solid
tokens.usage: Text on a solid chip (PLAN).

families.stroke: "Share Tech Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Stroke scale 2: zone titles, chip text, dial labels, the TURN caption. Caps only.

styles.name: turn-box
styles.usage: Stroke scale 4: the turn number beside the timer, in orange.

styles.name: dial-number
styles.usage: Stroke scale 5 (6 on a wide dial): the gauge reading, zero-padded to two digits, in the dial's colour.

styles.name: timer
styles.usage: Stroke scale 6 at the 4-row header: the running turn clock, white while a turn runs, grey idle.

styles.name: row
styles.usage: SHELL and LOG rows are terminal text, one cell high, drawn by the engine, not the rasterizer.

spacing.note: Logical pixels. The rasterizer draws at zoom 2, so a 1px stroke is 2 device pixels and lands under one of the user's 14x28 terminal cells.

tokens.name: cell-w
tokens.usage: One terminal column. Every picture is a whole number of cells wide.

tokens.name: cell-h
tokens.usage: One terminal row. Every picture is a whole number of cells tall.

tokens.name: stroke
tokens.usage: Lines, figure strokes, chip outlines, the title rule.

tokens.name: stroke-bold
tokens.usage: The dial needle, bold text strokes.

tokens.name: gap
tokens.usage: Between chips, between the title text and its rule.

tokens.name: chip-pad
tokens.usage: Inside a chip, left and right of the text.

tokens.name: chip-h
tokens.usage: A chip is exactly one cell tall.

tokens.name: ladder-w
tokens.usage: Width of a ladder pip.

tokens.name: ladder-pitch
tokens.usage: Vertical pitch of ladder pips: 3px lit, 2px dark.

tokens.name: ladder-seg
tokens.usage: Height of one ladder pip.

tokens.name: ladder-gap
tokens.usage: Between the ladder and the chips to its left.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: The TURN header: 4 rows.

tokens.name: figure-h
tokens.usage: A crew figure: 7 rows.

tokens.name: lead-w
tokens.usage: The lead figure: 14 columns. Helpers take 18 columns at most, or the width of their name.

tokens.name: clock-w
tokens.usage: The clock side of the header: 30 columns.

tokens.name: machine-w
tokens.usage: The machine side of the header: 22 columns, chips then the ladder.

tokens.name: title-w
tokens.usage: A zone title picture: 9 columns, one row.

tokens.name: figure-box
tokens.usage: The athlete drawing space: a 64x64 viewBox, feet on y=60, scaled to the shorter side of its box.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Nothing is rounded. Chips are 1px rectangles; only the stroke font rounds a corner, with a point or two on the way round.

tokens.name: zoom
tokens.usage: Logical to device pixels. Keep strokes 1-2px logical so they stay under a device pixel.

tokens.name: stroke-cap
tokens.usage: Cap height of the stroke font in logical px per unit of scale: scale 2 is 10px tall.

tokens.name: stroke-advance
tokens.usage: Logical px one character advances per unit of scale.
